summary: feat(settings): enlarge Pair V2 device details text
description:
Because:

* Pair V2 device details text was small, light grey and hard to read.

This commit:

* Sets text-sm, text-grey-900, rounded-lg and break-word on the box on the three Pair2 screens.
* Moves text-xs to the DeviceInfoBlock default wrapper, so V1 pages do not change.
* Adds tests for the new box style and the default text size.

Closes FXA-14832
